mostWorthwhile.text: The contrast between chosen simplicity and forced poverty made Diogenes' ideal more useful and less misleading.

leastWorthwhile.text: The conclusion that local popularity alone cannot establish a good life was clear but predictable.

surprise.text: Stoic attention to one's own judgments led to a broader idea of fellowship beyond a single city.

arbitrary.text: The connection from self-command to concern for others was not initially clear, though the final result explained it.
